onboarding.title: Private safety and independence preparation
onboarding.subtitle: Take your time. You are in control of every step. No account or personal identification is required.

privacyStep.title: Privacy & session
privacyStep.description: Your safety and privacy come first. EXIT runs completely in your browser's temporary memory.
privacyStep.memoryOptionDesc: Runs entirely in temporary memory. When you close this tab or tap Quick Exit, all information is instantly erased.
privacyStep.localOptionDesc: Secure, PIN/passphrase-protected encrypted local saving is planned for a future release. For your safety, this milestone continues in memory-only mode.
privacyStep.guarantee1: No account creation, email, or phone number required.
privacyStep.guarantee2: No GPS, contacts, camera, or background permissions requested.
privacyStep.guarantee3: Zero survivor data leaves your device tab.

deviceSafetyStep.title: Device & communication safety
deviceSafetyStep.description: Answering these quick questions helps us configure safety settings like Quiet Mode for your device.
deviceSafetyStep.q1Title: Is it safe to receive notifications on this device?
deviceSafetyStep.q1Desc: If someone else checks your lock screen or phone, notifications might be seen.
deviceSafetyStep.q2Title: Does anyone else have access to this device?
deviceSafetyStep.q2Desc: Such as knowing your passcode, using your tablet, or looking at your browser history.
deviceSafetyStep.q3Title: Are any accounts or location shared with someone else?
deviceSafetyStep.q3Desc: Such as shared Apple/Google Family accounts, find-my-device, or shared email logins.
deviceSafetyStep.quietModeAutoNoticeDesc: Because your device or accounts may be accessed by others, Quiet Mode has been enabled to prevent alerts and keep the interface discreet.
deviceSafetyStep.quietModeManualToggleLabel: Enable Quiet Mode for this session
deviceSafetyStep.quietModeManualToggleDesc: Suppresses all popups and subtle notifications.

needsStep.title: What areas would you like to prepare for?
needsStep.description: Select only what is relevant to your situation right now. You can choose one, multiple, or skip.

communicationSafety.title: Communication safety
communicationSafety.description: Safe phone habits, secure messaging, and identifying trusted contacts if safe.

documents.title: Essential documents
documents.description: Identity cards, birth certificates, deeds, bank records, and document checklists.

money.title: Money & financial independence
money.description: Independent emergency funds, private bank access, and income continuity.

housing.title: Safe accommodation
housing.description: Temporary housing options, safe shelter pathways, and transition considerations.

children.title: Children & dependents
children.description: Childcare essentials, school continuity, dependent health, and custody considerations.

health.title: Health & medical care
health.description: Prescriptions, chronic care medications, urgent healthcare, and counselling pathways.

legal.title: Legal information
legal.description: Understanding protection orders, legal aid resources, and formal rights pathways.

digitalSafety.title: Digital & account security
digitalSafety.description: Reviewing account logins, location sharing, spyware checks, and password safety.

work.title: Work & livelihood
work.description: Workplace discretion, independent salary accounts, and employment safety.

summaryStep.description: Here is a summary of your session setup. All information remains in temporary memory.
summaryStep.storageStatusValue: In-memory only (zero trace upon tab close)
summaryStep.noNeedsSelected: No specific areas selected yet (you can add areas anytime)

planDashboard.title: Your Private Safety Plan
planDashboard.subtitle: Active in-memory session. Nothing is saved to disk or network.
planDashboard.noAreasSelectedDesc: You can add or update planning areas at any time.
